resolution.question: Loomis & Hale LLP signed a new client this morning. Will the two sides agree on a kickoff meeting time within 72 hours of the engagement letter being signed?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, before the hard cutoff, the persistent event history shows that both parties have explicitly agreed on a specific date and time for a kickoff meeting (e.g., via email, calendar invitation, or other documented communication). Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
